title: The Chronicle, So Far
description: Reach SkyRPG Level 35 and tell Hollis the tale.

giver.name: Hollis Barrowmead
giver.text: You came in as a stranger. Now look at you. I'd like to hear every tale of it, from the first stew. But first, a few more levels, would you? A legend should be properly levelled.

rewards.hint: More chapters will follow. For now, the whole sky is yours.
